data.name: Knight
data.notes:
The starter character in Dungeon Slasher. Newer players should aim to get the Oberon (Weapon) to help them cheese through the Dungeon.
Reacquiring this character via Season Pass will reward 3,000 Gems instead.

Recommended Mastery: 1131.

skins.description:
This is the Knight's default skin.
Reawakened by the call of the distant yet close goddess and saint, they rose within the dark dungeon.
Slowly clenching and unclenching their fingers, they feel their senses returning.
As they grip the hilt of the rusted iron sword they held, their heart begins to throb violently, ahead of their reason.
First, they must escape this dungeon.
The one and only star of the vast and glorious empire.

A blond prince perfect for the blue beach.
You've run tirelessly for the peace of the world-so just this once, how about focusing on a bit of "vacation"?
Could the knight really be a woman?
A knight dressed in a butler's outfit. Who might they serve?

A soldier whose body is made of cards.
If they stand sideways just right, maybe you won't see them?

If one bears the mission of saving the world, then the sacred ground is a place they must visit.
For the knight's cause, for the world, and for Caecilia
- they must grow stronger.

Imitating a dungeon scientist full of experimental spirit. Wearing this outfit makes it feel like any modification will succeed.

"..What's that chemical smell?" -Knight-
This is the Mad Bomber who rules the deep underground arsenal.
With dazzling lightning, you can instantly incinerate your enemies.
A tragic hero who returned across eons of solitude to bring 'salvation' to himself.

She has put on a new style of outfit so that no one can recognize her past self.

This is the Mercenary's default skin.
It matters not where he came from or for whom he fights.
The only thing that matters is the fact that not a single enemy who stood in the way of the one wearing this outfit escaped unharmed.
...(Silence)

A gift should always bring joy to the one who receives it. This Santa has a very special gift to offer.

He is a lifeguard responsible for the safety of guests visiting the resort. It is said that if you don't follow the safety rules, you'll be buried in the sand with only your head sticking out.

Once upon a time, there lived a caterpillar who loved hookah. Be careful when speaking to him.
If you ever mention that he's short... your remaining lifespan might end up shorter than that drifting puff of smoke.

It mimics someone from the depths of the Prison Camp.

A heroic heroine who casually carries a greatsword as large as herself and enjoys her tipsiness, shouting,

"Have another drink! There is no gift as sweet as a drink on the battlefield!"

* You can freely change your outfit status through the dummy that appears upon entering the dungeon.
